item.title: Step -Futari no Kankei wa Ippo Zutsu-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AMEDEO
  • 発売日: 2006-12-15
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (33 人評価)
  • 日本語名: STEP ―二人の関係は一歩ずつ―
  • 英語名: Step -Futari no Kankei wa Ippo Zutsu-

あらすじ

Akino Minori returns to her hometown after her parents went abroad due to work. She was supposed to live with her grandparents, but they are on a long trip, so she starts living with her uncle, Kouta. She meets her childhood friends Yuu and Mizuho. Her romantic life now begins.
